reply_text:
㊥ Gist: The outcome of a yes is now one dim, indented line with short ids, for example `✓ agreed: option 2 of act:31e3fc8d (agreement act:32ab1363)`. There's no "system:" name, no blank line after it, and no "agreement only, no grant", since the next turn's header already gives the full ids and says that. It's loaded in your Emacs and committed (60e214e1). To check it rendered, I inserted one sample line for the agreement you just made, so you'll see it once above your prompt.

㊢ (the other forms) A refusal or failure gets the same dim style:
- `? yes was ambiguous; the agent will ask which`
- `✗ yes not recorded: withdrawn`
- `✗ yes not checked: http 403, evidence-not-operator-turn`
- `✗ yes not checked: timeout`

The line you quoted, "grant unknown until unknown", came from the null-grant fault I fixed last turn.

㊬ (what I checked) The agent-chat ERT tests pass, 57 of 57. I updated the expected strings and added one test that the line is a single shadow-face line with shortened ids and no "system:" prefix. In your buffer, the sample line has the `shadow` face.

㊟ (what I didn't change) Only the acceptance lines changed. agent-chat.el has about 20 other places that print a full "system:" message, including the undo line. If you want those quieter too, `agent-chat--insert-note` is the function they could switch to, one at a time.

claude-17
previous_reply_acts.text: (the grant display) The server sends `"grant": null` when an agreement grants nothing. Emacs reads JSON null as `:null`, which isn't nil, so the line went down the branch for agreements that come with a grant. The fault was there before today's change. It showed up now because this was the first time the Emacs line, not the server's header notice, reported an agreement with no grant.
